t: You are looking at the New West End Synagogue, on St Petersburgh Place in Bayswater. It is a Grade I listed building and an Orthodox Jewish congregation, which has belonged to the United Synagogue since 1879. The architect was George Ashdown Audsley, who was also an artist, illustrator, writer and decorator. He designed pipe organs too, and today he is probably best known for the Wanamaker Organ in Philadelphia.
